title: Micro Managing Naval Adventure Game
author: ShoogarSoft
selftext:
So I'm moving on to my next project, which is a previous project I was making in Godot and got stuck because debugging was hell. This time, I am making it in ThreeJS because aside from an easier entry, I actually prefer making my own systems and engines, rather than be limited with what is set in place.

Before diving into the actual game like before, I decided to place elements and particularly, element builders. I reused and improved sprite and texture generation from previous projects so that I will have a better hand in the visuals. I then set off to make the scene builder for cinematics because promotion later on will be a headache.

But before anything else, I want to see if the concept will fly.

So there are a lot of naval games out there, but they're about the exciting parts like combat, pirates, treasure hunting... trading? Or, about puzzles, and sunken ships. When I watch movies about ancient naval stories, I keep thinking, how do they manage their stocks and keep themselves alive for a long time at sea?

That is where this game comes in. It's about managing your journeys to be able to get from A to B with everyone healthy and happy. We manage food supplies and their expirations, without refrigeration, but with salt and other techniques. Manage each crews' roles and schedule to make sure the ship is well maintained and running throughout. There will be combat, and I will probably use Windrose type of controls, but it will be more involved on who're manning the guns, with their stats, skills, and health.

I will probably adapt the Rimworld style of character development, where crews' personalities will affect how they work and interact with you and the others. World lore that you can uncover in your exploration. But, that are all future plans.

For now, I am just looking for a show of hands (or likes), if this is a project you would be interested to see develop.
